claims.statement: Separating a concealed action from the apparent moment of change may make a fictional demonstration easier to follow without identifying when preparation occurred.
claims.excerpt: Separating a concealed action from the apparent moment of change may make a fictional demonstration easier to follow without identifying when preparation occurred.
claims.magic_application: Use temporal separation as an analysis prompt, not as an exposed method instruction.

claims.statement: A clearly motivated visible gesture may shape audience expectation and concentrate attention on the apparent event.
claims.excerpt: A clearly motivated visible gesture may shape audience expectation and concentrate attention on the apparent event.
claims.magic_application: Evaluate whether the visible action gives the audience a coherent event to follow.

claims.statement: The fictional Vanishing Token demonstration uses a motivated open-hand gesture as part of its audience-facing presentation.
claims.excerpt: The fictional Vanishing Token demonstration uses a motivated open-hand gesture as part of its audience-facing presentation.
claims.magic_application: Connect an audience-perceived effect to a presentation-level technique.

claims.statement: Selective attention may help explain why an audience prioritizes a motivated visible gesture in the fictional Vanishing Token demonstration.
claims.excerpt: Selective attention may help explain why an audience prioritizes a motivated visible gesture in the fictional Vanishing Token demonstration.
claims.magic_application: Use selective attention as a bounded explanatory hypothesis for the fictional effect.

claims.statement: Working Memory may help describe why a fictional audience benefits when the Vanishing Token script presents one clear instruction at a time.
claims.excerpt: Working Memory may help describe why a fictional audience benefits when the Vanishing Token script presents one clear instruction at a time.
claims.magic_application: Use Working Memory only as a prompt for reviewing script complexity.

claims.statement: Prediction Error may describe the fictional audience's revision of expectation when the token is no longer present after the visible gesture.
claims.excerpt: Prediction Error may describe the fictional audience's revision of expectation when the token is no longer present after the visible gesture.
claims.magic_application: Use Prediction Error as an interpretive label, not as proof of a measured audience response.

claims.statement: The fictional Vanishing Token presentation uses Audience Management to establish where the demonstration is visible and when the audience should observe the token.
claims.excerpt: The fictional Vanishing Token presentation uses Audience Management to establish where the demonstration is visible and when the audience should observe the token.
claims.magic_application: Represent audience conditions without describing a secret handling method.

claims.statement: In the fictional presentation, Audience Management uses the motivated open-hand gesture as a visible coordination cue.
claims.excerpt: In the fictional presentation, Audience Management uses the motivated open-hand gesture as a visible coordination cue.
claims.magic_application: Review whether a visible cue coordinates attention without coercing participation.

claims.statement: The fictional Vanishing Token presentation uses Misdirection as a non-procedural plan for prioritizing the visible gesture and the apparent event.
claims.excerpt: The fictional Vanishing Token presentation uses Misdirection as a non-procedural plan for prioritizing the visible gesture and the apparent event.
claims.magic_application: Model Misdirection at the level of audience experience, without operational secret detail.

claims.statement: The fictional Vanishing Token presentation uses Temporal Separation to keep the apparent change distinct from earlier preparation in the narrative timeline.
claims.excerpt: The fictional Vanishing Token presentation uses Temporal Separation to keep the apparent change distinct from earlier preparation in the narrative timeline.
claims.magic_application: Inspect the narrative timing without exposing a method.

nodes.name: Vanishing Token
nodes.description: A fictional, non-procedural demonstration used only by the public demo corpus.
nodes.definition: The audience perceives a small token as present and then absent after a motivated gesture.

nodes.name: Motivated Open-Hand Gesture
nodes.description: A presentation skill rather than a secret handling method.
nodes.definition: An executable performance gesture whose visible purpose is clear within the presentation.

nodes.name: Expectation Framing
nodes.description: An applied principle describing how presentation shapes what an audience anticipates.
nodes.definition: Presentation cues establish a plausible expectation that guides interpretation of the apparent event.

nodes.name: Selective Attention
nodes.description: A general cognitive construct represented only as a synthetic demo concept.
nodes.definition: Limited processing is prioritized toward some available information over other information.

nodes.name: Working Memory
nodes.description: A bounded cognitive construct included as a synthetic demo concept.
nodes.definition: A limited-capacity system for temporarily maintaining and manipulating information relevant to an ongoing task.

nodes.name: Prediction Error
nodes.description: A synthetic representation of mismatch between an anticipated and an observed event.
nodes.definition: A discrepancy between a prediction and subsequent input that may prompt revision of expectation.

nodes.name: Audience Management
nodes.description: An executable performance skill for coordinating participation, visibility, and attention conditions.
nodes.definition: The performer deliberately establishes clear observation and participation conditions for an audience-facing demonstration.

nodes.name: Misdirection
nodes.description: An applied performance principle for organizing audience attention and interpretation.
nodes.definition: Audience priorities are shaped around motivated visible events while alternative interpretations remain less salient.

nodes.name: Temporal Separation
nodes.description: An executable routine-construction skill represented without operational method detail.
nodes.definition: The performer structures the narrative timeline so preparation and the audience-perceived event occupy distinct moments.
